prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” marketing agency — the right one depends on what you need (brand work vs. performance marketing), your industry, budget, timeline, and whether you want a large full‑service shop or a small boutique. A couple of Kansas City agencies that are widely recognized and worth considering:

- Barkley — KC‑based, strong in creative and brand work for national accounts. Good if you need big creative campaigns and brand strategy.
- VML/VMLY&R — global network with roots in Kansas City; strong integrated capabilities across creative, digital, and experience design.

How I can help next
- Tell me what you need (services: branding, web, SEO, PPC, social, B2B vs B2C), your budget range, and whether you need a local partner — I’ll shortlist 4–6 KC agencies that match and include recent case studies and estimated price ranges.
- Or I can pull a broader list from review sites (Clutch, Ad Age, KC Business Journal) and summarize strengths/weaknesses.

Which approach do you prefer, and what are your goals/budget?
